newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, OCTOBER 8-THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, OCTOBER 8-THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-178/94, C-179/94, C-188/94, C-189/94 and C-190/94 Dillenkofer: institutional law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 90/314/EEC of June 13, 1990, on voyages, vacations and package tours. Measures for the protection of consumers. Consequences for a member state of the faulty or tardy transposition of a directive. Obligation to compensate for damages caused to individuals. Conditions. - Oral procedure C-357/95-P ENU v/ Commission: contracts. Appeal against court judgment rendered September 15, 1995, in cases T-458/93 and T-523/93: ENU v/ Commission. EAEC treaty. Disposal of uranium production. - (1000/0800 GMT) Oral procedure joined cases C-65/95 and C-111/95 Shingara: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 9 of Council directive 64/221/EEC of February 25, 1964, on the coordination of special measures concerning the movement and residence of foreign nationals justified on grounds of public policy, public security or public health.

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-109/95 Astir: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 10, paragraph 4 of Commission regulation 2730/79 of November 29, 1979, on common application measures on export refunds for agricultural products. Export towards third countries other than the USSR. Wheat flour. Calculation of the refund in cases of loss of exported product owing to absolute necessity. - Opinion C-152/95 Macon: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2 of Council regulation 1637/91 of June 13, 1991, fixing compensation with regard to the reduction of the reference quantities referred to in Article 5c of Regulation 804/68 and compensation for the definitive discontinuation of milk production. Quality of "milk producer" within the meaning of regulation 857/84 of March 31, 1984. Agricultural operator not producing milk, but having reference quantities of milk exempt from the supplementary levy at his disposal through direct sale.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged) (1400/1200 GMT) - Judgment T-24/93 Compagnie Maritime Belge v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 23, 1992, on an application procedure under EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Joint agreements and practices and abuse of dominant position in the domain of maritime transport between Northern Europe and West Africa. Annulment or reduction of the fine imposed on claimants. - Judgment T-25/93 Dafra-Lines v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 23, 1992, on an application procedure under EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Joint agreements and practices and abuse of dominant position in the domain of maritime transport between Northern Europe and West Africa. Annulment or reduction of the fine imposed on claimants. - Judgment T-26/93 Deutsche Afrika-Linien v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 23, 1992, on an application procedure under EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Joint agreements and practices and abuse of dominant position in the domain of maritime transport between Northern Europe and West Africa. Annulment or reduction of the fine imposed on claimants. - Judgment T-28/93 Nedlloyd Lijnen v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 23, 1992, on an application procedure under EC treaty articles 85 and 86. Joint agreements and practices and abuse of dominant position in the domain of maritime transport between Northern Europe and West Africa. Annulment or reduction of the fine imposed on claimants. - Oral procedure T-106/95 FFSA v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of February 21, 1995, which does not regard the tax advantages to the benefit of the French Post Office in the exercise of its competitive activities as state aid within the meaning of EC treaty article 92.

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-245/94 and C-312/94 Hoever: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, paragraph 1(h) and 73 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, article 4, paragraph 1 of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters and of article 7 of regulation 1612/68 of October 15, 1968. Educational grant paid to a parent exercising no professional activity in order to devote him or herself to a child under 18 months old. - Judgment C-78/95 Magenta Druck and Verlag: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 27, points I and 2, and 29 of the Brussels convention. Recognition of a decision. Motives for refusal. Defendant not considered at fault by the original judge, but considered inadequately represented in legal proceedings and not kept regularly informed in a timely or useful manner of court or equivalent proceedings.

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-298/94 Henke: social policy. - Judgment C-311/94 Ijssel-Vliet Combinatie: state aid. - Opinion joined cases C-9/95, C-23/95 and G-156/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. - Opinion C-13/95 Suezen: social policy. - Opinion joined cases C-71/95, C-155/95 and C-271/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-343/95 Diego Cali and Figli: competition.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0715 GMT) - Judgment joined cases T-336/94 Efisol v/ Commission: environment and consumers.
COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-241/95 Accrington Beef: trade policy.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-283/94, C-291/94 and C-292/94 Denkavit International: taxation. - Judgment C-64/95 Lubella: agriculture. - Judgment C-312/95 Commission v/ Luxembourg: environment and consumers. - Opinion C-139/95 Balestra: social policy. - Opinion C-298/95 Commission v/ Germany: environment and consumers.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-313/95 Commission v/ Italy: agriculture.
